import hashlib
import unittest

from solution import AuthenticationError, PermitDesk


def digest(pin):
    return hashlib.sha256(pin.encode()).hexdigest()


class PermitDeskTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_login_tokens_profiles_and_failed_login_counter(self):
        desk = PermitDesk([
            {"identifier": "alice", "pin_hash": digest("1234"), "profile": {"roles": ["reader"]}},
            {"identifier": "bob", "pin_hash": digest("xyz"), "profile": {}},
        ])
        with self.assertRaises(AuthenticationError):
            desk.login("alice", "wrong")
        with self.assertRaises(AuthenticationError):
            desk.login("missing", "1234")

        first = desk.login("alice", "1234")
        second = desk.login("bob", "xyz")
        self.assertEqual(first, {"access": "A1", "refresh": "R1", "profile": {"roles": ["reader"]}})
        self.assertEqual(second, {"access": "A2", "refresh": "R2", "profile": {}})

    def test_renew_has_independent_counter_and_refresh_remains_valid(self):
        desk = PermitDesk([
            {"identifier": "alice", "pin_hash": digest("pin"), "profile": {}}
        ])
        tokens = desk.login("alice", "pin")
        self.assertEqual(desk.renew(tokens["refresh"]), "A1")
        self.assertEqual(desk.renew(tokens["refresh"]), "A2")
        desk.login("alice", "pin")
        self.assertEqual(desk.renew(tokens["refresh"]), "A3")

    def test_unknown_and_malformed_refresh_tokens(self):
        desk = PermitDesk([])
        for token in ("R1", "", None, 1, b"R1"):
            with self.subTest(token=token):
                with self.assertRaises(AuthenticationError):
                    desk.renew(token)

    def test_deep_copy_on_construction_and_return(self):
        profile = {"settings": {"colors": ["red"]}}
        records = [{"identifier": "a", "pin_hash": digest("p"), "profile": profile}]
        desk = PermitDesk(records)
        profile["settings"]["colors"].append("blue")
        records[0]["profile"]["extra"] = True

        first = desk.login("a", "p")
        self.assertEqual(first["profile"], {"settings": {"colors": ["red"]}})
        first["profile"]["settings"]["colors"].append("green")
        first["profile"]["changed"] = True
        second = desk.login("a", "p")
        self.assertEqual(second["profile"], {"settings": {"colors": ["red"]}})
        self.assertIsNot(first["profile"], second["profile"])

    def test_constructor_type_errors(self):
        for records in (None, (), {}, "records"):
            with self.subTest(records=records):
                with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
                    PermitDesk(records)
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            PermitDesk([[]])
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            PermitDesk([{"identifier": 1, "pin_hash": "x", "profile": {}}])
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            PermitDesk([{"identifier": "a", "pin_hash": 1, "profile": {}}])
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            PermitDesk([{"identifier": "a", "pin_hash": "x", "profile": []}])

    def test_constructor_content_errors(self):
        valid = {"identifier": "a", "pin_hash": "x", "profile": {}}
        for record in (
            {"identifier": "a", "pin_hash": "x"},
            {"identifier": "a", "pin_hash": "x", "profile": {}, "extra": 1},
            {"identifier": "", "pin_hash": "x", "profile": {}},
            {"identifier": "a", "pin_hash": "", "profile": {}},
        ):
            with self.subTest(record=record):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    PermitDesk([record])
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            PermitDesk([valid, {"identifier": "a", "pin_hash": "y", "profile": {}}])

    def test_login_argument_types(self):
        desk = PermitDesk([])
        for identifier, pin in ((1, "p"), ("a", 1), (None, "p"), ("a", None)):
            with self.subTest(identifier=identifier, pin=pin):
                with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
                    desk.login(identifier, pin)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
